lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape sachaa sabad milaae ||
lines.translation: The True Lord Himself unites us in the Word of His Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੇ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabade vichahu bharam chukaae ||
lines.translation: Within the Shabad, doubt is driven out.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੮॥੨੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam milai vadiaaee naame hee sukh paaidaa ||16||8||22||
lines.translation: O Nanak, He blesses us with His Naam, and throgh the Naam, peace is found. ||16||8||22||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: agam agochar veparavaahe ||
lines.translation: He is inaccessible, unfathomable and self-sustaining.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape miharavaan agam athaahe ||
lines.translation: He Himself is merciful, inaccessible and unlimited.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪੜਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮੇਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: apaR koi na sakai tis no gurasabadee melaaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: No one can reach up to Him; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is met. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁਨੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: tudhuno sevahi jo tudh bhaavahi ||
lines.translation: He alone serves You, who pleases You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabade sach samaavahi ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Shabad, he merges in the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: anadin gun ravahi din raatee rasanaa har ras bhaaiaa ||2||
lines.translation: Night and day, he chants the Lord's Praises, day and night; his tongue savors and delights in the sublime essence of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਮਰਣੁ ਸਵਾਰਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabad marahi se maran savaarahi ||
lines.translation: Those who die in the Shabad - their death is exalted and glorified.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ke gun hiradai ur dhaarahi ||
lines.translation: They enshrine the Lord's Glories in their hearts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: janam saphal har charanee laage doojaa bhaau chukaaiaa ||3||
lines.translation: Holding tight to the Guru's feet, their lives becomes prosperous, and they are rid of the love of duality. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮੇਲੇ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jeeu mele aap milaae ||
lines.translation: The Dear Lord unites them in Union with Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabade aap gavaae ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Shabad, self-conceit is dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਾਤੇ ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: anadin sadaa har bhagatee raate is jag mahi laahaa paaiaa ||4||
lines.translation: Those who remain attuned to devotional worship to the Lord, night and day, earn the profit in this world. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਾ ਮੈ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tere gun kahaa mai kahan na jaaee ||
lines.translation: What Glorious Virtues of Yours should I describe? I cannot describe them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)t na paaraa keemat nahee paaee ||
lines.translation: You have no end or limitation. Your value cannot be estimated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: aape daiaa kare sukhadaataa gun mahi gunee samaaiaa ||5||
lines.translation: When the Giver of peace Himself bestows His Mercy, the virtuous are absorbed in virtue. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਹੈ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: is jag mahi mohu hai paasaaraa ||
lines.translation: In this world, emotional attachment is spread all over.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਅੰਧਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh agiaanee a(n)dh a(n)dhaaraa ||
lines.translation: The ignorant, self-willed manmukh is immersed in utter darkness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੰਧੈ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: dha(n)dhai dhaavat janam gavaaiaa bin naavai dukh paaiaa ||6||
lines.translation: Chasing after worldly affairs, he wastes away his life in vain; without the Name, he suffers in pain. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: karam hovai taa satigur paae ||
lines.translation: If God grants His Grace, then one finds the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai mail sabad jalaae ||
lines.translation: Through the Shabad, the filth of egotism is burned away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: man niramal giaan ratan chaanan agiaan a(n)dher gavaaiaa ||7||
lines.translation: The mind becomes immaculate, and the jewel of spiritual wisdom brings enlightenment; the darkness of spiritual ignorance is dispelled. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਅਨੇਕ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tere naam anek keemat nahee paaee ||
lines.translation: Your Names are countless; Your value cannot be estimated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach naam har hiradai vasaaee ||
lines.translation: I enshrine the Lord's True Name within my heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਉਣੁ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: keemat kaun kare prabh teree too aape sahaj samaaiaa ||8||
lines.translation: Who can estimate Your value, God? You are immersed and absorbed in Yourself. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam amolak agam apaaraa ||
lines.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is priceless, inaccessible and infinite.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਆ ਤੋਲਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa ko hoaa tolanahaaraa ||
lines.translation: No one can weigh it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਤੋਲੇ ਤੋਲਿ ਤੋਲਾਏ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮੇਲਿ ਤੋਲਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: aape tole tol tolaae gurasabadee mel tolaaiaa ||9||
lines.translation: You Yourself weigh, and estimate all; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, You unite, when the weight is perfect. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sevak sevahi karahi aradaas ||
lines.translation: Your servant serves, and offers this prayer.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਬਹਾਲਹਿ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: too aape mel bahaalahi paas ||
lines.translation: Please, let me sit near You, and unite me with Yourself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: sabhanaa jeeaa kaa sukhadaataa poorai karam dhiaaiaa ||10||
lines.translation: You are the Giver of peace to all beings; by perfect karma, we meditate on You. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਜਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jat sat sa(n)jam j sach kamaavai ||
lines.translation: Chastity, truth and self-control come by practicing and living the Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu man niramal j har gun gaavai ||
lines.translation: This mind becomes immaculate and pure, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: is bikh mahi a(n)mrit paraapat hovai har jeeu mere bhaaiaa ||11||
lines.translation: In this world of poison, the Ambrosial Nectar is obtained, if it pleases my Dear Lord. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no bujhaae soee boojhai ||
lines.translation: He alone understands, whom God inspires to understand.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਅੰਦਰੁ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har gun gaavai a(n)dar soojhai ||
lines.translation: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, one's inner being is awakened.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਏ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: haumai meraa thaak rahaae sahaje hee sach paaiaa ||12||
lines.translation: Egotism and possessiveness are silenced and subdued, and one intuitively finds the True Lord. ||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਹੋਰ ਫਿਰੈ ਘਨੇਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin karamaa hor phirai ghaneree ||
lines.translation: Without good karma, countless others wander around.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਚੁਕੈ ਨ ਫੇਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: mar mar ja(n)mai chukai na pheree ||
lines.translation: They die, and die again, only to be reborn; they cannot escape the cycle of reincarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਕਾ ਰਾਤਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: bikh kaa raataa bikh kamaavai sukh na kabahoo paaiaa ||13||
lines.translation: Imbued with poison, they practice poison and corruption, and they never find peace. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੇ ਭੇਖ ਕਰੇ ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bahute bhekh kare bhekhadhaaree ||
lines.translation: Many disguise themselves with religious robes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin sabadai haumai kinai na maaree ||
lines.translation: Without the Shabad, no one has conquered egotism.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: jeevat marai taa mukat paae sachai naai samaaiaa ||14||
lines.translation: One who remains dead while yet alive is liberated, and merges in the True Name. ||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਇਸੁ ਤਨਹਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: agiaan trisanaa is tanahi jalaae ||
lines.translation: Spiritual ignorance and desire burn this human body.
